prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: implementation design reference board for DadalCode algorithm figure renderer families.
Primary request: redesign the FIGURES only, preserving an existing dark charcoal Python learning app. One large landscape 3 by 3 design board, nine readable figure examples, each in an open dark canvas with its small title. All UI and figures will be implemented as accessible interactive HTML/SVG, not a shipped raster screenshot.
Palette: matte #111315 backdrop, #191c20 surfaces, #2b3036 borders, near-white text, slate secondary, lime #c1f17a current pointer, amber #e5b66e changed values, blue #83bde6 frontier. No gradients/glows/photography.
Typography: Inter labels, monospace values, generous spacing and clear hierarchy.
Panels: 1 "Arrays & strings" indexed rounded square values [2,7,11,15], active 7 with i pointer and a thin bracket beneath left/right bounds. 2 "Linked lists" horizontal rounded rectangular nodes, separate value and next-port cells, directional arrows, values 1→2→3→None, head/current pointer labels above. 3 "Trees & tries" circular tree nodes, spacious left/right branches with small L/R edge labels, double-ring terminal node for tries. 4 "Graphs" circular nodes 0,1,2,3, distinct directed arcs and frontier dashed ring; topology clear and readable. 5 "Matrices & boards" coordinate headers, 4 by 4 square cells, highlighted row/column, current cell lime, edited cell amber. 6 "Dynamic programming" prefix-indexed row [1,1,2,3,5], previous and current values visibly separated and current index clear. 7 "Maps & sets" proper Key/Value table with 2:0 and 7:1, amber changed row; small set of unique token chips below. 8 "Stacks, queues & heaps" vertical LIFO stack next to horizontal FIFO queue, top/front endpoints labeled, tiny binary heap root. 9 "Intervals & bits" three aligned interval tracks on shared numeric axis with endpoint labels outside bars, two byte groups of bit squares with bit index annotations.
Constraints: no app navigation, no invented marketing copy, no decorative icons, no excessive framing. All nine panels equally legible; establish faithful implementable family shapes and semantic state colors.
